GOOD TO KNOW

A few things you
might be wondering.

Will it use my actual hall photo?+

Yes. Your venue photograph is the main reference. The selected décor image guides the flowers, colours and decorative details. AI aims to retain the room and perspective, but it can still alter details.

Does this tell me whether the décor will physically fit?+

No. This is a visual idea, not a measurement or installation plan. Our team needs your venue dimensions and access details to confirm what is practical.

What happens to my uploaded photo?+

Choosing a photo previews it on your device. Only when you agree and generate is a resized copy sent through our server to OpenAI. We do not save photos or results to a gallery or database. Provider retention policies apply. Clear the studio or close this page to remove its in-page copies.

Can I share the result with your team?+

Yes. Download the result, open WhatsApp and attach the image yourself. Tell us your date and venue so we can discuss your ideas.
